summary: The HSPnetDropDownList is a custom dropdown list control that extends the capabilities of a standard ASP.NET DropDownList. It includes additional properties and behaviors for handling options, particularly with a focus on an 'ALL' option.
purpose: To provide a customizable dropdown list control that can highlight options and handle additional properties for specific application needs, such as managing a default 'ALL' option.

fields.name: ALL
fields.description: Determines if the 'ALL' option is included in the dropdown.

fields.name: FirstItemIsALL
fields.description: Indicates whether the first item in the dropdown is the 'ALL' option.

workflows.name: Dropdown Rendering
steps: On pre-rendering, evaluate the selected index.
If the selected index is greater than 0, add a red color style to the dropdown.
Iterate through each item to assign color styles based on the selection state.

business_rules: The first item in the dropdown list can be an 'ALL' option if configured.
Color styling is applied to highlight selected items and differentiate them from the 'ALL' option.

conditions.name: Color Change
conditions.condition: If an option other than the first is selected, apply a red color style.

system_behavior: The dropdown list will change its color based on the selection, defaulting to red if any option besides 'ALL' is selected.
